name: shadcncraft
tagline: shadcn/ui components, blocks and a matching Figma kit
description: A production design system built on top of shadcn/ui with one-to-one Figma and React parity: every block exists in both places with the same states and tokens. Aimed squarely at AI workflows, a Figma plugin exports layouts straight to React and the registry ships as agent skills for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex.

best.title: shadcncraft
best.note: 245 blocks and 116 components, Figma and React side by side.
